 Jeremiah Fears, Herb Jones, Saddiq Bey, Zion Williamson and Yves Missi will start against the Nuggets on Saturday.

 Yves Missi (knee) is available to play against the Nuggets on Saturday. 
 Missi will be back following an 11-game absence. He’ll be on a minutes restriction, though he could still end up starting. DeAndre Jordan started on Friday and would likely return to the bench. Karlo Matković will also lose out on minutes after taking on a larger role with Missi out.

 Yves Missi (knee) is probable for Saturday’s game against the Nuggets. 
 Missi has missed the last 11 games, but is likely to return Saturday given his probable status. Missi’s return will mean less playing time for Karlo Matkovic.

 The Pelicans will start Jeremiah Fears, Herbert Jones, Saddiq Bey, Zion Williamson, and DeAndre Jordan on Friday against the Grizzlies. 
 There have been two changes to the starting lineup from the past game against the Nets. Saddiq Bey is starting in place of Dejounte Murray who is reportedly not playing for the Pelicans again, and DeAndre Jordan will replace Karlo Matković in the starting lineup.

 Forward

 Trey Murphy (knee) and Yves Missi (knee) are out for Friday’s matchup with the Grizzlies. 
 After receiving doubtful tags on Thursday, both players are unsurprisingly unavailable against Memphis. With Dejounte Murray (ankle) doubtful, expect Saddiq Bey, Karlo Matković and Herb Jones to see bumps in playing time.

 NOP 
 Forward 
 #25 
 Trey Murphy (knee) and Yves Missi (knee) are doubtful for Friday’s matchup with the Grizzlies. 
 Murphy will miss a third straight game, and Missi will be sidelined for an 11th straight. With the pair expected to sit out against Memphis, Saddiq Bey and Karlo Matkovic should continue to handle additional playing time. 
 Yves Missi 
 NOP 
 Center 
 #21 
 Yves Missi (knee) is out for Saturday’s game against the Hawks. 
 Injured during the Pelicans’ October 23 game against the Jazz, Missi is expected to miss significant time with a left knee bone bruise. DeAndre Jordan has replaced him in the starting lineup on most nights, but Karlo Matković got the nod for Thursday’s win over the Kings. Despite coming off the bench, Derik Queen offers a higher fantasy ceiling than Jordan or Matković. 
 Herbert Jones 
 NOP 
 Forward 
 #2 
 Jeremiah Fears, Herbert Jones, Trey Murphy, Zion Williamson and Karlo Matković will start against the Kings on Thursday. 
 With Dejounte Murray (personal) sidelined for this game, Jones will step into the starting unit. His role this season has been minimal, but he should benefit from the expanded opportunity in this game. However, this may just be a one-game boost. The other change to the starting unit is Matković replacing DeAndre Jordan, which will make this Matković’s first start. 
 DeAndre Jordan 
 NOP

 Jeremiah Fears, Dejounte Murray, Trey Murphy, Zion Williamson and DeAndre Jordan will start Saturday’s game against the Nuggets. 
 With Yves Missi suffering a bone bruise in his knee during Friday’s loss to the Jazz, the Pelicans had a hole to fill at center. Instead of Derik Queen, Jordan will fill the void. While an interesting choice, Jordan offers better defense than Queen.

 #21 
 Yves Missi (knee) is out for Saturday’s game against the Nuggets. 
 Missi banged knees with Zion Williamson, left Friday’s game against the Jazz and didn’t return. Without Missi on Saturday, expect Derik Queen and Karlo Matkovic to pick up minutes against the Nuggets.

 Center 
 #21 
 Yves Missi (knee) will not return against Jazz after being helped to the locker room. 
 Yves fell down after Zion Williamson fell into his knee. He was down for a couple minutes and then was carried to the locker room. If he misses time, Derik Queen and Karlo Matkovic will pick up the minutes.
